correctness.rationale: Derivatives y³,xy²,w³,zw² force y=w=0 and x=z, hence unique P; in U=x+z coordinates F=x(Y³+W³)+(U⁴+UW³), primitive linear xH+G with coprime H,G ensures integral normal hypersurface by Serre R1/S2. On W=1, H=Y³+1, G=U⁴+U: three distinct cube roots Y and four U∈F4, transverse intersection (dH/dY=Y²≠0,dG/dU=1). Four quartic sections [G:YH:UH+G:WH] resolve projection from P upon blowing up the CI, L=4h−sum E with L²=4. The three H-factor lines each pass through four basepoints and meet at nonbasepoint Q; strict transforms have self-intersection −3 and pairwise intersection1, and these are exactly curves contracted to P, giving minimal resolution. Lines through P iff their direction satisfies H=G=0, hence twelve. Local affine f=u⁴+v³+(1+u)t³ has Tjurina ideal (u⁴,v²,t²), quotient length16. Leray plus H²(O_X)=k, H²(O_resolution)=0 and H¹=0 yield geometric genus1; triple-point blowup gives SNC star (-1;-4,-4,-4).
